device.type: Compact DVB-S2 Full HD H.265/HEVC satellite receiver with Conax / MultiCAS card reader, Ethernet, USB Wi-Fi and external IR/LED eye
device.soc: ALi M3521A / C3505 (128 MB DDR3 dual-CPU H.265/HEVC SoC reading chip ID 0x3505; NIM_C3505_0, NIM_S3501_1, OSD_DEV_0/1/2, seecode "M3606 SEE" at 0xA6000200)

source.site: satedu.cba.pl (a mirror of the Amiko / Edision firmware archive)
source.author: Amiko / Edision
source.note: Archive AMIKO_Mini_HD265_1.3.66_emu.abs from AMIKO MINI HD265; added for expanded coverage.

simulator.note: Boots as a 128 MB DDR3 C3505 board (chips/c3505.py, run_dump_mini_hd265_v1521_app_starts.py, run_dump_mini_hd265_v1521_capture_screen.py): the boot-ROM bootloader runs in boot SRAM at 0x9FE00800, unpacks maincode(AV) ("6B000A001521", 11.10 MB) to 0x80000200 and seecode ("M3606 SEE") to 0xA6000200, and starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x86002001).  The application drives the CH455 front panel on GPIO 107 / 110 (" ON " -> " on "), populates userdb(64+64) from defaultdb(PRC) over SPI, and renders its 1280x720 ARGB8888 OSD through the display engine at 0xB8006900.

desc: Amiko Mini HD265 (System ID 6B000A00) firmware 1.5.21 Edision (2020-12-16) for the compact Full HD H.265/HEVC DVB-S2 satellite receiver on the ALi M3521A / C3505 SoC with 128 MB DDR3 and 8 MB SPI flash.

Shares the 6B000A00 hardware platform with the Amiko HD8155: uses a "maincode(AV)" application chunk at 0x060000, a CH455 (TM1650-compatible) 4-digit LED display on GPIO 107 / 110, and the Amiko 0x60xx remote control table ("necfirst" coding).
